reviews.text: First time here and diffently will be back. Good service at a great price.

So I went for my cat and dog and TRUST ME ! AMAZING service! Great prices! Loved it. I'm a pet sitter and I always recommend this place to my clients ! It's cheap and does the job 🫶🏻🐾 edit! Forgot to mention how much it costs me lol! For my dog and cats vaccines it was around $120 and when I took my dog only it was $70 for his yearly shots !

I came here after our baby was diagnosed with heart worms 6 months ago. The other vet office didn’t renew her prescription last month with no explanation or reaching out, they were shady to say the least. I decided to make an appointment here even though it’s a little further. They are so worth it! The experience here was a the total opposite of what I experienced at the other vet office. They were so pleasant and the dr was so sweet, they took care of my dog’s needs right away! She is very anxious and doesn’t do well in social environments but they were so patient and accommodating. I am 100% satisfied with the care and pricing!
I had a great experience here

Dr. Dietz was a great vet! Prices were fair and I felt like I could actually afford getting treatment for my dog's immediate needs without getting upsold on multiple other treatments and services. My usually feisty little dog was also at ease with their great staff!

Clean facility and wonderful staff all around. I felt that my pet was cared for with love and kindness and I was informed about all treatment options before and during the appointment. I experienced hardly any wait time and my experience overall was superb. Will definitely be back!
Took a severly ill dog on Labor Day and received exceptional care

I was absolutely amazed with the availability of walk ins & even more amazed with the staff and affordable cost!!! I left feeling confident my Max is in good hands for treatment of his skin infection and I will definitely be making this Max’s primary care going forward!
Dr was very knowledgeable and gave me good advice about my senior dog. So thankful for his service. Medium sized dog Shih-Tzu

Low cost pet vet is awesome. The office staff are so kind and caring. Love Dr. Ward and Dr. Dietz. Great care at affordable prices. Understanding and helpful. They go above and beyond. I would definitely recommend this vet clinic to anyone in need of Veterinary care services.  They treat my dogs with care and dignity.

Front desk staff needs more training on empathy and professionalism, specifically Joshua. Didn't even greet me just looked past me when I asked him a question on how I could get my pet seen same day. Although there was only one person in the waiting room, he said there was no time for me to be seen today. When I asked for an appointment he slapped a piece of copy paper on the table and asked me to write my information down instead of him doing in on the computer like a professional business normally does. It took compassion from the one person on the waiting room for him to finally change his approach when helping me. This kind of behavior only adds stress to the situation when trying to get help, I wouldn't be walking in for no reason, I obviously needed help and if help wasn't available, there could've been a better way to handle the situation.
Not a fancy place, but knowledgeable, reasonable prices and good with my three kitties.

Please don’t come to this place, they are money hungry, they don’t care about your pet, they just want your money. They don’t tell you your pets health problems. If you want your pet to be healthy and cared for go to another vet, but if you want to be ripped off and mistreated by all means come here.

I rarely leave reviews at all but if I were you I would avoid this place, the Technicians have no compassion and were seriously rude, everytime I had a question they would ask me the same thing back like if i was a Vet myself. They kept slamming the door on me after every interaction and had a clear attitude.

Save your time and avoid coming here. Inconsistency when it comes to your pets health. They constantly tell you it’s a new arising issue just for you to keep bringing your pet here. They do not care about your pet, I promise you that! Long wait time and lots of miscommunication.
Clean Friendly and Knowledgeable and Caring Staff
Walk in sunday clinic on West Ave is great! My goldendoodle received all her annual shots and the wait and appointment was less than 30 minutes. Very efficient checkin process.

Sparkle goes in for a check up once or twice a year and to get flea meds. She's always feels comfortable around the staff and they're friendly and take time to answer any questions and show love. We're very happy with Low Cost Pet Vet
Friendly staff and excellent prices!! Dogs loved both the attention and treats they received. Win win!
Today was Milo’s first vet experience and it was great. Milo was a little nervous but, the staff did a wonderful job making Milo comfortable and the cost was affordable.
Very kind and helpful staff. Very knowledgeable. I didn't wait long at all to be seen. Will definitely be taking my cats back!
Great people
Friendly and great customer service.. Prices are fair but least expensive than other veterinarian and every annual visit my baby gets a new toy.
We witness a large dog almost killing a small dog. I recommend scanning the QR code and sitting in your car till your turn comes. Staff was very pleasant and personable

Very nice and friendly but so irritating that no one ever answers the phone or gets back to you and then you walk in and all 3 people that are usually there are just sitting there chatting doing nothing when you walk in with pretty much no one really there after you have tried calling almost all day 3 people and no one can pick the phone up

Wonderful experience beginning to end. We just adopted our 2yr old pittie and he has some skin issues. They talked everything through clearly. The team is invested in his health and development. I booked appt on their website and also was contacted via the phone plus email to make sure we could coordinate a good date. We went to their main office. Just getting to know my new fur babe so we peeked our head in to “Check in” and then hang outside till it was our appt. They happily accommodated us. Not 5 min and we were called in. Weighed him right away (66lb!♥️) then went into private room. Highly recommended going here! Looking forward to our next appt. Thanks again!
Dr Ward was thorough, patient and knowledgeable.

Got both my dogs in quickly for updated  blood work and shots.   Friendly staff,  got everything done and out the door in about 45 minutes.  Great experience and not the $$$$$ that other vets have quoted since I've been back in SA.
Very friendly
Excellent care, explained things well….careful with our kitten, greatly priced, pleasant atmosphere. Feelings of trust, care, and concern everywhere. Highly recommend!
Jimmy dietz the doctor was so nice!!! - Jupiter the kitty

I recently rescued a stray kitten, and I had no idea just how difficult and heartbreaking it would be to get him the medical care he desperately needed. I called countless clinics all over San Antonio, and each time I was met with cold rejection and a complete lack of willingness to help this terrified little soul. It was incredibly painful to feel so helpless, but then I found Dr. Ward at Low Cost Pet Vet — and everything changed.

Speaking with Celest was a breath of fresh air; her kindness and professionalism shone through as she patiently answered all my questions, which seemed endless. She took the time to explain their process, the treatments, and the costs with genuine compassion, making me feel like I wasn’t just a number but someone who truly mattered. Thanks to her, I was able to bring my tiny, scared kitten in immediately.

From the moment we arrived, the staff and Dr. Ward radiated warmth and genuine care. Dr. Ward’s calm and gentle approach immediately put my trembling kitten at ease. I could see the difference in his nerves melting away as he received comforting ear and chin rubs from a truly caring hand. The thoroughness of the examination was incredible, and every member of the team treated us with kindness and compassion. Best of all, the cost was affordable, lifting a huge weight off my shoulders.

I am wholeheartedly committed to bringing all my pets to see Dr. Ward, and I want to support small businesses like this within our community—places that treat our animals with love, respect, and genuine care.
We always get good service for our dog. Their staff are friendly and so helpful. Thank you for taking good care of our pet.
I really do recommend them , they have good client service and they have patience with your dogs .

Second visit to Low Cost Pet Vet and I was not disappointed.  They have lower medication and office visit costs than the majority of veterinary clinics.  The weight time for appointments will likely go past the time set, but I find that at most places and you have the option to wait in your car until a room opens, which is perfect for my 80lb pit-bull who’s reactive. The staff is very friendly, knowledgeable and has always allowed me time to explain what’s going on with my baby.  I couldn’t be happier with their services.
Amazing staff and very affordable prices!!! ❤️😇

Excellent service and excellent treatment. All the staff were very kind to us and, above all, very affectionate with Matilda.

Yes, there is a bit of a wait, but it's completely understandable given the high demand they have for so many dogs. As owners, we should also be mindful and bring them a toy, water, or something to keep them calm while they wait.

Without a doubt, the service is worth it. You can tell they work with dedication and that they truly care about the animals' well-being. I recommend this place with complete confidence and will continue to bring Matilda. 🐾🐶🦴❤️💉
All the staff is kind.
Great service, staff is friendly and kind. Service was fast and easy 10/10
They are very friendly and have great service I have been bringing my Shih Tzu and he has gotten excellent care every time
Best of San Antonio

My pup was in really bad condition, hotspots all over her body, ear infection, she wasn’t well. I am grateful for the advice and direction Dr. Ward gave me to help my pup, his approach to healing her gut was new to me. We went to many vets before and he was truly the best, it was a long road to recovery but I saw improvements following his directions, she is healthy and thriving now. And I know that with his oversight and knowledge my pup will continue to have a good quality of life.
Great service and reasonable prices
Excellent service

Took our cat in when she was having difficulty urinating. They gave her and antibiotic shot that helped right away and got her feeling better. The staff and vet tech were very professional, friendly, and informative. We will keep bringing our pets here.

We came here after our dog got heartworms and the treatment was going to cost over $2000 luckily we heard about this place and the same procedure cost less than $1000 plus the energy of all the workers at low cost vet is contangiois, you know they care alot about the animals.
I love bringing my dogs here. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The meds and services are very affordable.

1st visit: This place on West Ave. are scammers. They want to charge you for stuff that is not needed. Also, their customer service is bad. They hardly ever answer the phone. There's a girl just sitting there, doing nothing while the phone is ringing and ringing and not answer the phone. The other girl was so nice, which made up for her.
Today i called several times before i got an answer and the girl on the phone was very short and i can almost hear her rolling her eyes. lol i would ask a question and she would take her time to answer me, like she was bothered with my questions.
The staff is very friendly, and the vet is also a very kind gentleman who explains things very well and answers any questions you might have.
Waited close to two hours for a simple cytopoint injection. And a $24 technician fee for what exactly? Basically put the injection myself

Even though it’s really hot outside these guys they go through it with you. They move really fast. They have a process where you scan a barcode and they text you when it’s your turn to come up and they’re fast. I can say that they’re fast and it’s good because it’s really hot outside. It can’t get a little packed, but I mean it’s just them doing their job. I mean they can’t help that they’re going as fast as they can. I took my Yorkie.Ysabeau For her shots for the full package, I believe I paid 65 that’s including the rabies and I purchased a three month supply of flea protection which was I believe it was 75 altogether. It was $141 for an entire year of shots and a three month supply of flea meds in one chewable that’s good enough for me. I mean you can’t expect to have everything for free you know people gotta live so if you think that that’s expensive then I’m totally against people saying. “ If you can’t provide for your animal, you shouldn’t have one” But for this price, if you really can’t afford this respectfully, it’s probably not a good idea as much as you would want an animal it’s probably not a good idea to have one because they really do need their vaccinations. They do need flea meds cause being constantly bit over and over and over and over again, you know that’s that’s miserable, but other than that these guys are they’re on it and I live. I’m gonna say 10 minutes from them and I’ll continue to visit this location as long as it’s there.
Great people very nice Doctor. I would take my puppy back to Low Cost vet.
It was a great experience at this clinic. Facility was clean, the staff were friendly and helpful. Veterinarian was super nice and treated my puppy with kindness and care.

After being told by penny paws that my dog was heartworm positive. Brought both of my dogs  here, dr and staff were understanding and kind. They re tested to be sure and my dogs ended up being negative!  Very kind and informative staff, quoting for heartworm treatment was very affordable. Bought heartworm prevention! Thank you again!

I'm totally satisfied with Low Cost Pet Vet. I had the pleasure of getting my Chihuahuas vaccines on a Saturday at their Mobile Pet Station in my local neighborhood. This accommodating service for pet owners is a plus. They conveniently set up at various locations on Saturday and Sunday for the convenience of pet owners that work. Stations are open 10:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. plus vaccines are very reasonably priced. Very courteous staff at both locations.  I'd scheduled my dog for a Gland Express procedure at the Lamanda/West Ave office.  I highly recommend them. Courteous, knowledgeable and friendly. LCPV makes sure that your pet is relaxed and comfortable in their care. My dog showed NO signs of any discomfort after being treated. I assure you that I'll definitely be taking my pet to this facility whenever she requires pet care. I'm glad to have found such a facility to treat my pet and that I can trust without any hesitation. I sincerely recommend them to anyone needing pet care for their little loved family member. Thank you for being so careful and caring you relaxed me to not hesitate you handling or caring for my little Chihuahua.
Ms Barrientes ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Plus
..
Staff was very friendly and helpful, they kept my dog calm and the doctor was very knowledgeable. They made sure all my questions were answered. Thank you low cost staff!
My experience was very exceptional and pleasing my buddy Casper was give the best  treatment that I was hoping for and the staff was very informative both the Dr and the Technician and I thank them .

I went today and had my PUPPY seen for his last round of puppy shots and one of the girl technicians miss handled my puppy. She was pinching him very hard to the point that my puppy was screaming ( yes he’s dramatic but she was pinching him instead of pulling his fur the get the skin up to give him the shots) Now TWO hours later my puppy is uncontrollably shaking and screaming in pain from today’s visit.
Just the only thing is you need to have an appointment for a sick pet or they won't see you
They offer the possibility of low-cost vaccines.
I use there mobile vet services. Every Sunday they are at pet’s barn providing veterinary services.

First visit to Low Cost Pet Vet and Jennifer was amazing with my dog Lyla! She was attentive, patient, and seems to really care about the animals. We enjoyed our visit and that says a lot about us since Lyla usually finds vet visits terrifying.

Wonderful experience all around! Dr. Dietz and Ilsa were so friendly and took great care of my best bud. I cannot recommend this place enough.

Thank you so much,
-Dalton and Dude

Reception refused service even though my dog was bleeding from her ear asked me to go to another vet but didnt give recommendations. Sad that they only service prior patients not walk ins or accept new patients.

If I could give 0 stars, I would. I tried getting an appointment, but it was impossible. I sent emails and called. When they finally emailed me back, they offered me a day, and I responded right away. They never replied until the next day, saying that day was no longer available. I had already requested the day off so I could take my dog in. They offer me a different date into now still no response. I never have issues with their mobile clinic.

I have had such a great experience each time I have dealt with Low Cost Pet Vet. The receptionists, Yamileth and Paola, are truly amazing — always kind, professional, welcoming, and so helpful. They make everything such a smooth and pleasant experience. It is hard to find great customer service these days, and they consistently go above and beyond. I highly recommend Low Cost Pet Vet to anyone looking for caring and affordable veterinary services!
Each Sunday they have appointments and you can get vaccinations and what ever your pet needs help with without paying the doctors visit so it will be more affordable for what ever need your pet has.

Very poor service. Tried several times to call and no one ever answers the phone? Then when you go down one of their maze of options it tells you to give them a call rather than solving in another way. Again how does that help if you don't receive an answer to your call?? Moving on to someone who understands what customer service is.

Don’t go here. The communication with them is absolutely abysmal. I took my dog in on Feb 9 because she was having some issues. Waited for an hour until we were finally seen. Bloodwork was drawn and tests were sent in. Got a call back from them, it’s a tumor diagnosis. I then had some follow up questions about some cancer treatment facilities that they could send a referral to. I called. Nobody answered the phone, left a voicemail, never got a returned call. So I found out their email address. Emailed them. The order of events from then on:

Feb 19: emailed
*no response from them*

Feb 23: follow up email
*still no response*

Feb 24: called, no answer

Feb 25: another follow up email sent.
Finally a response later that day.

Feb 28: sent another email telling them which oncologist to refer my dog to
*no response again*

March 3: called, no answer

March 4: follow up email sent asking for a confirmation that the referral was sent over

March 5: email from them saying the referral was sent.

March 5: oncology place called right away and was confused as to why I was being referred to them when no other tests had been done officially confirming the tumor.

March 6: I contact another vet to move my dogs care over to them. New vet sends over email requesting my dogs records.

March 9: I go to the new vet for an appt with my dog, and guess what? No records were sent over. So then I had leave that vet, drive to low cost pet vet, and PHYSICALLY SHOW UP IN PERSON TO GET MY DOGS RECORDS. Then the lady at the counter saw the email request and sent over the records as she’s printing out the records for me. Ridiculous.

And considering my dog had just been diagnosed with a cancerous tumor this is pretty serious. You all should not be playing around with pets life like this.

Go literally anywhere else.

I called for almost 30 minutes i desperately needed a vet and I preferably cannot jump straight to er prices. When they finally answered they left me on hold for another almost 30 minutes. Just hung up and took my pet to the nearest vet.

If I could leave less than a star. I would this place never answers the phone like ever. All you get is a machine all day long and when you go they are not even open.  Customer service obviously horrible. Don't recommend this place.
This place is great! My pets loves the staff and they take good care and even call to follow up.

I rarely leave reviews, but I strongly do not recommend this vet. There is a serious lack of communication both among staff and with clients. I was given incorrect information about my puppy being allowed outside, which could have put his health at risk. Only after calling back did I receive the correct guidance. This kind of inconsistency is unacceptable. It also feels like they push unnecessary return visits, costing you more money. I would not trust this clinic with my pet’s care—save your money and go elsewhere.

Arrived to the appointment and had to wait an hour. Not how appointments work by the way. Made me late to my job even though I scheduled the appointment 2 hours before I needed to be at work. Had to call multiple times to get someone to answer the phone to schedule the appointment. Unprofessional and understaffed but has no problem booking an appointment that they will make you wait an hour plus for… again… not how appointments work.
Fast service

Well, my cat died today waiting for the vet to verify the medication, because their manager was on vacation so couldn't verify. There seriously needs to be a different process done to prevent things like this happening in the future or maybe start carrying the medicines pets need or order it for us and have us pick it up, or something.

Both
Ladies are very nice and sweet, vet tech very nice she answer my questions she took the time , vet took his time talking to me about my nala, very caring, I recommend this place.
It was the first time I took my lab beau Lou to  a low cost clinic, they were friendly and got the job done fast, I would definitely  use them for your pet.

I had an appointment this morning at 9:30 when I got there at 9:25 they told me there would be a substantial weight there were four people ahead of me so I said I can't wait that long can I reschedule it for the following day but I forgot I have a doctor's appointment following day so I called them and said I'm not going to come in now I'll come in at a later date but I don't know what and could they refund me the $20 and they said no they wouldn't do that because I didn't go through with the appointment they're the ones that didn't provide the appointment the way they were supposed to but it's my fault and they won't refund the money if that's the kind of business they do I don't want to use them anyway be warned

Whooo, 198.00 for injection y and e pills, I feel they stole my money, we went there looking for Pay less. And pay more , don't go there. Was charged 40.00 for pill you can get e at pet mart for 13.oo
The office is extremely clean, and the staff are super friendly. The doctor is very attentive and caring. I will be back with my doggy.

I had an appointment today and it was wonderful! From the moment I walked in until I left I felt heard, seen & understood! Everyone was nice and professional! The doctor was personable and friendly! Carni Boy, my dog, was nervous at first, but they put him right at ease! Thank you so much! I would highly recommend!
You can't get nobody on the phone and getting an appointment is impossible to none. I've been trying two months.

Let me start by saying that this place is amazing, affordable, and educational.  Dr Ward and Elsa helped my dog Zoey throughout the process. They both educated me on everything that was wrong with my dog that I just rescued from a horrible situation. They were very sincere and happy that I rescued her. She came back positive on multiple tests that were needed but everything is treatable and both of them made sure not to exceed what is not needed. Let me say that that is very hard to find. Anywhere else this entire process would have cost me three times more than what I paid at this Vet. They have fully gained my trust and I am extremely thankful that I found this place.

Thank You
Dr. Ward and Elsa

Another vet prescribed my cat meloxicam for two months which caused his kidneys to fail since it’s actually a dog medication and not used for long term in cats, or used off label short term. He had lost two pounds, I didn’t think he would make it. This office had test results in 24 hours, ended up helping me do iv fluids at home, and the total for two visits was only about $350. I couldn’t be happier. He is thriving again, they absolutely saved his life and I am so thankful. 10/10
Fast and friendly service !!

Took my cat in for a swollen eye didn’t really know the cause .. doctor was very nice and informative .. prescribed my cat some eye drops and gave her some shots. Her eye was looking better that same week Paid about $175 …

I was so pleased with the care and concern for my dog. After each visit, the clinic would call to check on my dog.  When we put down our dog, the staff were very sensitive to our needs.  They called and sent a card of condolences signed by the staff personnel.  I highly recommend this clinic!

This place was horrible. I feel robbed of 500. I brought my Coco here because he was not walking at all. Went in, everything seemed great had some X-rays done and sent on my way with 3 precipitations and told I’d receive the images and receipt as well as my Coco should feel better the following day. Next day he was worse. Took him somewhere else and was told my Coco needed to be put to sleep. He suffered an extra day and we were given hope just to live through a prolonged heartbreak. This place and employees should be ashamed of themselves. What kind of place would do this to people and their beloved pets/babies.

Very affordable, probably most affordable in town. The Drs and staff are kind. Waiting time can vary, sometimes I am in and out in an hour others I’m there for 2-3hrs. It just depends. It’s not a quick clinic but for good care and not to big a dent in my pocket I’m okay with the wait. I hope they expand one day or get the proper equipment to be able to do everything in house. Like ultrasounds and minor surgeries.
They were quick, friendly and best of all they have the lowest prices for pet vaccinations!  Highly recommend

I am so grateful to have found this clinic! They were super friendly on the phone, answered all my questions, and got me set up for an appointment ASAP. I came in with a stray and a lot of questions, and they made sure he was healthy and that I understood everything. The wellness check was thorough, and we left prepared to care for him. They were incredible with the dog from start to finish—one of the best experiences I’ve had in San Antonio. Their prices are very reasonable, and they take the time to explain treatments so you can afford and understand them. Truly top-tier care and service!
Great place for pets to go

Staff was friendly. I use their mobile units to get annual check ups and flea prevention. Most recently visited their brick and mortar West Ave location for dental plaque removal. Our 7 year old baby had to have several bad teeth removed. They treated him well and feel that they did a okay job. I see some Visible plaque or build up around the gum line on several teeth, for the $700+ bill I shouldn't see anything..?

Vet stated I can only prevent spread/growth of plaque build up that has occurred cannot be removed with home dental chews or bones only by a professional.
They have the most affordable exam fee I have found at 45$. They are very attentive and nice at the front desk

Paid $927 for two mastiff dogs
Not too bad since I usually pay $1200 at Dr.Becker Vet by i-10. Saved a few hundred. Still pricey but so far this is the cheapest I can find.

They make a mistake with your pets vaccines and then have a horrible attitude when you call them on their mistake. They don’t chart your pets medical records like a normal Vet office. You have to ensure your pets gets what it needs and doesn’t. The techs don’t check the chart or ask you questions, just jab.
They let your pets die from their inconvenience and incompetence

They have all digital check in and receipt for all their work. The one thing I do not like. It is efficient system.
They treated my fur baby very professional no doubt I highly recommend them for your pets care. The cost compared with other places is awesome and very good.
Great place, very professional and affordable. Thank you staff for your wonderful service  from blue and Supreme ❤️

Can’t complain , this place has always been amazing to me and my furry friends. Everyone is always very friendly and welcoming, front desk girls greet with a smile and always willing to answer all my questions. The vet that I’ve seen has also been great and you can tell his love for the animals along with the experience. Over all great place that lives up to their name! PAWsome!!
Excellent service

We had to put down our 16 1/2 year old dog Dakota because he was having seizures, constantly having stomach issues and he was pretty much blind. He couldn’t go up and down the stairs anymore without slipping and falling and was choking when he would eat. The staff was very nice. The Dr was so very kind and sympathetic towards my daughter and I. Hardest thing I ever had to do. We miss him so much

Decided to try a new vet for our dogs and was pleasantly surprised by the great experience we had during our first visit. Staff was incredibly nice and took care of us pretty quickly. Dr. Ward was very thourough when giving our dog her exam. He is very knowledgeable and attentive - we could tell our dog felt very comfortable as well unlike other places we have gone to. Elsa the tech also did a great job and the prices were very reasonable too. We look forward to coming back again.
They saved my baby Lulu 💝 …
I understand this is pet clinic but I've never smelled other pet clinics this terrible.  Great staff!

This is the best veterinary clinic I have been too. The great service and compassion started with the ladies upn front from the time ai called to schedule. The receptionists, techs and Dr's were so compassionate, and listened to my concerns. They were so gentle with my 18 year old baby. I would highly recommend this place.
Friendly staff & reasonable prices compared to other vets I researched
These people are extremely caring and try very hard to give you options. I would recommend them above any other in town.

This place is amazing let’s just start there. Staff were attentive, informative, & responsive. The Vet does his job in an efficient manner while making sure your pet is safe & happy. Vaccines went by quick and easy. I was in and out of my appointment within 30 mins. The only problem I have is the scheduling. I had to come back for a certain procedure for my dog that they had to do another day. I then requested the day after my payday so I would have the money. Well I’m not sure if it’s a misunderstanding or I wasn’t loud enough but my appointment was pushed up by 2 days. I received the confirmation not thinking anything about the date, I was looking forward to coming on Dec 19 instead of Dec 17. Meanwhile I called in the AM on Dec 19 to get it sorted out but I was told I wasn’t going to be seen and the next day was the Dec 20 but I will be on like a first call list for something they scheduled wrong. The next actual appointment is like a whole week later and I already waited 2 weeks. I take accountability for my mistake so should the staff as well. Make sure you put the day you scheduled in your phone or something for your reference purposes.
Great experience!

Rude front desk people!
Don’t take your dog to get Spayed.
It’s a meat market. They put all the animals in a row and do their thing.
Had a real bad experience.

They are nowhere near low cost!
Too expensive!
This place is the worst. You go in for help and they won’t see you unless you have  appointment. No patients in the lobby and everyone sitting around. Save your time and go someplace else 🤷🏻‍♂️ …
Super fast, low cost, super clean it was safe for my puppy!
Love them very affordable ty for making it affordable for people 2 take care of our pets in this hard time with economy changing

I took my baby Henry here a year ago and the visit was nice and smooth. I recently took him here and the doctor was really great with him and gave my baby some meds to get better. He was really professional and informative. I can’t say the same about his assistant. She made me feel bad. She would say snarky comments and made it seem like I didn’t care for my dog properly. She was really judgmental and unprofessional. I have to see him again in two weeks. I hope she’s a lot more professional than my last visit
Great place and you can really save some money!!
